title: UIBC agent card receipt report line
description: One line of a JSON Lines file produced by `uibc_core.pyz verify-agent-card-receipt --report`. It carries the decision, the one of sixteen reason tokens that produced it, and the digest the verifier computed over the card as served — so a reader of the report can recompute that digest from the card and check the verifier's arithmetic without trusting it. The exit code follows the suite's contract: 0 accept, 1 reject, 3 unreadable case.

vector.description: The corpus member (one case directory) this line is about.

result.description: PASS only for `accept`; FAIL for any `reject`, whichever rule produced it; ERROR when the case could not be read. PASS is a conforming answer about the receipt, never an approval of the agent.

decision.description: null only on an ERROR line. `accept` requires the reason `receipt_current`; there is one accepting reason and fifteen refusing ones.

reason.description: One of the suite's sixteen tokens: receipt_current, statement_malformed, statement_type_wrong, predicate_type_wrong, subject_malformed, predicate_malformed, validity_window_inverted, card_malformed, card_digest_mismatch, receipt_not_yet_valid, receipt_expired, revocation_list_absent, revocation_list_malformed, revocation_list_signature, revocation_list_stale, receipt_revoked. A missing list, an unreadable list, a list signed by a foreign key and a stale list are all refusals: none of them is a clean pass.

subject_digest.description: The SHA-256 the verifier computed over the RFC 8785 form of the card without its top-level signatures, lowercase hex. Null only when the card could not be read at all, or on an ERROR line; on `card_digest_mismatch` it is the digest that was computed, which is not the one the receipt names.

exit.description: The suite's contract: exit 0 for accept, 1 for reject, 3 for a case that could not be read. A refusal never exits 0.

error.description: Present only on an ERROR line, and required there.

$comment: Cross-field rules the subset here cannot express: PASS iff decision is accept, reason is receipt_current and exit is 0; FAIL iff decision is reject, reason is one of the fifteen refusing tokens and exit is 1; ERROR iff decision, reason and subject_digest are null, an error string is present and exit is 3; a PASS line's subject_digest is a 64-character lowercase hex string.
